Such that at least two of $\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y}, \mathrm{z}$ are integers is $-$
questions.solution:
$\begin{array}{l}
x+2 y+4 z=9 \\
2 x y+8 y z+4 x z=26 \\
(x)(2 y)(4 z)=24
\end{array}$
Say roots of $\mathrmP^{3}-9 \mathrmP^{2}+26 \mathrm{P}-24=0$ are $\mathrm{x}, 2 \mathrm{y}$ and $4 \mathrm{z}$
Here $(P-2)\left(P^{2}-7 P+12\right)=0(P-2)(P-3)(P-4)=0$

Hence there are five solutions.
